sk: Ide utrieť prach z hornej hrany dverí.
cz: Jde utřít prach z horní hrany dveří.
acceptable: She is going to {dust|dust off|wipe the dust off|wipe the dust from|wipe dust off|clean the dust off|clean the dust from} the top {of the door frame|of the doorframe|of the door|edge of the door|edge of the door frame}.
